sn48.69:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci asurānaṃ rukkhā, cittapāṭali tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
sn48.69:1.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhikā dhammā, paññindriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati yadidaṃ bodhāya.
sn48.69:1.4: saddhindriyaṃ bhikkhave, bodhipakkhiko dhammo. taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati …pe… paññindriyaṃ bodhipakkhiko dhammo. taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati.
sn48.69:1.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci asurānaṃ rukkhā, cittapāṭalī tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
sn48.69:1.6: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhikā dhammā, paññindriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ
